ck_audit_snapshot_counts_sane.name: ck_audit_snapshot_counts_sane
ck_audit_snapshot_counts_sane.value:
observed_count >= 0
      and sample_size >= 0
      and population_count >= 0
      and observed_count <= sample_size
      and sample_size <= population_count

ck_audit_snapshot_interval_contains_esti.name: ck_audit_snapshot_interval_contains_estimate
ck_audit_snapshot_interval_contains_esti.value: ci_low <= point_estimate and point_estimate <= ci_high and ci_low >= 0 and ci_high <= population_count

ck_audit_snapshot_impact_sane.name: ck_audit_snapshot_impact_sane
ck_audit_snapshot_impact_sane.value:
impact_score >= 0
        and severity_weight >= 0
        and severity_weight <= 1
        and impact_score <= point_estimate

ck_audit_snapshot_refusal_has_no_impact.name: ck_audit_snapshot_refusal_has_no_impact
ck_audit_snapshot_refusal_has_no_impact.value:
severity_class not in ('blocked', 'unknown', 'ok')
        or (impact_score = 0 and severity_weight = 0)

ck_audit_snapshot_evidence_tier_matches_.name: ck_audit_snapshot_evidence_tier_matches_coverage
ck_audit_snapshot_evidence_tier_matches_.value:
(evidence_tier = 'counted' and sample_size >= population_count)
        or (evidence_tier = 'estimated' and sample_size < population_count)
        or (evidence_tier = 'blocked' and observed_count = 0 and point_estimate = 0)
